visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in an indoor bedroom or living room area where a young man with black hair and black-rimmed glasses is seen lying on a couch, seemingly waking up with a startled expression. A smartphone is resting on his abdomen, displaying a red heart animation. Several blue and black Airwaves gum packets are scattered around him on the couch and attached to the wall behind him. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting his grey t-shirt and the messy environment. (2) The camera cuts to the man in a tiled bathroom, looking into a mirror while brushing his teeth with a blue toothbrush. He appears lethargic and tired. More Airwaves packets are visible on the bathroom counter near the sink. (3) Transitioning back to the couch, he is seen holding a white mug, looking dazed. He then picks up his smartphone and looks at it with a frustrated or tired expression. The background remains the same with the brown couch and scattered promotional gum packets. (4) A rapid sequence of promotional shots follows, showing the man holding different flavors of Airwaves gum in front of a white wall and a wooden shelf. He points at the packets and presents them to the camera. Interspersed are high-quality animated game character assets from 'Arena of Valor,' featuring characters with pink hair and futuristic outfits. (5) The man is shown opening a purple Airwaves 'Super' packet and placing two pieces of gum into his mouth. A stylized 'swirl' graphic appears over his head to indicate a refreshing sensation. He looks directly at the camera with wide eyes and an energized expression. (6) A four-way split-screen montage appears, showing the man playing a mobile game with intense and exaggerated facial expressions, ranging from shouting in excitement to focused concentration. (7) He is then seen holding a smartphone and a gum packet, scanning a QR code or entering a serial number on the screen. The camera focus is on his hands and the device. (8) A screen recording shows the game interface '傳說對決' (Arena of Valor) where he claims rewards. He initially looks disappointed when he doesn't get the top prize. (9) Suddenly, he is seen jumping for joy on the couch, surrounded by a much larger pile of Airwaves packets. He throws them in the air and laughs. The video concludes with a close-up of three gum packets (Cool Mint, Honey Lemon, and Super) and the man pointing at the viewer with a confident gesture.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a low-energy, groggy male voice speaking in Traditional Chinese, accompanied by a faint, steady alarm-like beep and no BGM. The speaker sounds tired and slow. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect triggers a transition, and high-energy, upbeat electronic BGM with a strong percussive beat starts playing immediately. The vocal tone shifts to an enthusiastic and professional narrative style, speaking rapidly about a promotional event. (3) Throughout the middle section, multiple digital UI 'ping' and 'click' sound effects are heard, simulating game interface interactions. There is also the audible crinkling of plastic gum packaging. The BGM remains consistent and driving. (4) A comic 'boing' or 'fail' sound effect occurs when the character initially fails a game draw, and the speaker's voice briefly drops in pitch and intensity to express disappointment. (5) The audio then surges again with a triumphal orchestral stinger and high-pitched shouting as the man celebrates. Fast-paced narration continues over the high-tempo BGM until the end, concluding with a final emphatic promotional slogan and a sharp cut to silence.

The video uses a relatable 'tired gamer' scenario to position the product as a necessary energy boost and highlights the incentive of winning in-game virtual items.
